title: The Green Gingerbread Christmas Puzzle Night
description: Green Gingerbread Christmas Puzzle Night: Christmas Gingerbread Village 1000-piece jigsaw puzzle, Sweet Water Decor tree mug, Christmas fuzzy socks, 5 pairs, Yankee Candle Balsam & Cedar large jar candle.
intro: My favourite Christmas night is not a party. It is a 1000-piece gingerbread village puzzle, a green tree mug of cocoa, a balsam and cedar candle, fuzzy Christmas socks and a buffalo plaid sherpa throw. Phone in the other room, a movie on in the background, and nobody leaves until the roof is done.

sections.heading: The puzzle
paragraphs: A Christmas Gingerbread Village 1000-piece jigsaw, about 27.5 by 19.7 inches finished, so it fits on the coffee table.

sections.heading: The cozy kit
paragraphs: A green Sweet Water Decor tree mug, a Yankee Candle Balsam and Cedar large jar, five pairs of Christmas fuzzy socks and a green buffalo plaid sherpa throw.
